rows.title: San Francisco Plumbing Code §104.0 — Permits
rows.publisher: American Legal Publishing / City and County of San Francisco
rows.supports: Directly retrieved §104.2 in chunk 13 (zero-based): leak repair, unstopping and faucet/fixture exemptions carry no-cutting/no-removal conditions. Chunk 14 contains §104.5 fees. Publisher disclaims definitive authority; confirm with DBI.
rows.limitations: Municipal code hosted by American Legal Publishing; retrieved chunk 13 for §104.2. Publisher says posted code may lag and is not definitive; confirm applicability with DBI.

rows.title: 2025 San Francisco Plumbing Code — Chapter 1, Section 104.0 Permits (§104.2 Exempt Work)
rows.publisher: City and County of San Francisco (SF.gov document library)
rows.supports: City-hosted code text retrieved 2026-11-10. §104.2 Exempt Work lists nine exemptions, each conditioned on not cutting into or removing piping: (1) repair of leaks, (2) unstopping of traps/sewers/vents/waste pipes, (3) replacement, repair or maintenance of faucets, angle stops, hose bibbs or roof drains, (4) toilet replacement, (5)-(9) further items. §104.1 adds that emergency work must have a permit obtained within one day of commencing.
rows.limitations: Amendment text only; the full code is the California Plumbing Code as amended by San Francisco. Job-specific applicability is a DBI determination and is not made here.

rows.title: Apply for a kitchen or bath remodel permit
